claim: For the 8-vertex cube graph \(Q_3\), the ordinary discrete Morse complex \(\mathcal M(Q_3)\) of all acyclic vertex–edge incidence matchings satisfies \[\mathcal M(Q_3)\simeq\bigvee^{4}S^5\vee\bigvee^{139}S^6.\] The homotopy equivalence follows from an explicitly enumerated acyclic matching with one critical vertex, 44 critical 5-cells and 179 critical 6-cells, whose 44-by-179 integral attaching-degree matrix has exactly 40 unit Smith invariant factors and zero other entries. The only nonzero reduced integral homology groups are \(\widetilde H_5\cong\mathbb Z^4\) and \(\widetilde H_6\cong\mathbb Z^{139}\).
integrity: Exact face enumeration, exhaustive acyclic Hasse check, signed integral critical boundary reduction with forty unit pivots, independently confirmed Smith normal form, mod-two direct boundary ranks.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for the ordinary cube graph Morse complex; no higher-dimensional hypercube theorem or equivariance; inaccessible directed-forest thesis is residual literature risk.
title: Integral homotopy of the ordinary Morse complex of the three-cube
